ANIMAL FACTORY TACTICS / SCENERY PARCEL C

Guard towers.

Three guard towers and a spotlight baked out of the 3D branch's painted library through this game's own camera, relit to match the painted catalogue, and planted on their tiles by the footprint centre the bake recorded. A tower fades while you look behind it. Nobody climbs them yet, and the lamps do not shine: that is parcel J. ← Game · Lamps and fires · Facility sprites

In the renderer

Drawn by environment-renderer.js, the function the game itself calls, on a grass yard, with a cow behind each tower and one in front. Move the pointer over a tower's upper half, where the ground under the pointer is behind it, and it fades by see-through.js, the rule the game uses. The overlay outlines each footprint and crosses its centre, the point the sprite is planted by.

The sprites

Original 1254 × 1254 transparent PNGs. The rules are the 3D branch's own: every one blocks its whole footprint, none gives cover and none blocks sight. On the 3D branch a guard can climb a tower and stand on top; here nobody can, so a 3D map that starts a guard on a tower post is refused. The fourteen other towers in the 3D gallery are not map kinds on either branch. See docs/tactics/TOWERS.md.
